svg.title: Excel-class ribbon, phase A
svg.desc: Four vector artboards: full Home ribbon, Insert ribbon, collapsed ribbon with separate state detail, and a 980 pixel responsive Home ribbon.
svg.text: 02 Insert / a different task, a different command set
03 Collapsed / document first, states kept explicit

g.text: The worksheet reclaims the command band. Select a tab to reveal commands.
Copy the selected cells to the clipboard.
Available while the worksheet has focus.

svg.text: 980 px · same control sizes · no horizontal scroll
Clipboard, Font and Alignment remain directly available.
Number, Styles, Cells and Editing become labeled menus.
Search stays centered. Collaboration stays at the trailing edge.
Secondary tabs move into More; labels and targets never shrink.
Static state study. Keyboard and command execution require the live specimen.
